## What's fixed
- The **Extensions → StatHubs** page (shop URL, login and QR code) now opens on OXID eShop 7.0. It failed there in 1.1.0.
- The StatHubs connection now also works on shops that display PHP warnings or notices on screen.

Tested on OXID eShop Community Edition 7.0.5 (PHP 8.1) and 7.5.2 (PHP 8.3).

## Update
```sh
composer update stathubs/oxid
vendor/bin/oe-console oe:cache:clear
```

## New installation
```sh
composer require stathubs/oxid
vendor/bin/oe-console oe:module:activate solu1stathubs
```
Then open **Extensions → StatHubs** in the admin and scan the QR code with the StatHubs app.

Without Composer: download `stathubs-oxid.zip` below and follow the [README](../../blob/v1.1.1/README.md#without-composer-zip).
